description: Show the project in the chat as a live preview that plays and follows every edit; a multi-page project turns its pages in the preview. Call it once per project, right after creating or opening it; later edits appear in the preview without calling again. Answers { name, pages, placards, durationSeconds, editorUrl }. Its result also carries one picture per page, a Morpha placard shaped like that page (up to 12, in page order): use it wherever you show a page, and never make or fetch a picture of your own. The preview lasts 30 minutes; call again if the person comes back later. `controls` picks the player's controls: 'full' (the default: play, a scrub bar, the time, sound and fullscreen) or 'play' (the play button alone, for a preview that should look like a plain video). In a client that cannot render a preview, give the person the editorUrl instead.
